title: Accounts Office Bulletin — Invoicing, Due Dates and Late Fees on Energy Monitoring & Performance Subscriptions
content:
# Invoicing, Due Dates and Late Fees

Accounts office bulletin on the billing terms of Energy Monitoring & Performance Subscriptions.

## Terms

The subscription fee, the per-meter fees and the gateway fee are invoiced together on the tier's billing frequency. Each invoice falls due the tier's payment term after the invoice date, counted in calendar days with the invoice day excluded and the due day included, and an invoice unpaid past its due day carries the tier's late fee for each month or part month it stays unpaid. Analyst overages, meter overages and dashboard user overages are invoiced in the period they arise. Payments are applied to the oldest unpaid invoice unless the owner names one. The billing frequency, the payment term and the late fee percentage are the figures fixed for the tier.

The late fee for one month or part month is the overdue amount multiplied by the tier's monthly late fee percentage, rounded to the nearest cent.

## Clause no longer in force

The following sentence of these terms is **no longer in force**, having been superseded by the current basis for settling a subscription in one payment; it is retained only so that it is not applied:

> *Credits — for a late report, for a shortfall paid as a credit, or for a billing adjustment — are applied to the next subscription invoice rather than refunded, except that a shortfall payment is made by cheque where the owner asks for one.* — no longer in force.

## Due date, worked (hypothetical)

An invoice dated 10 June on 30 day terms: 10 June is excluded, the count runs 11 June as day one, and the thirtieth day, 10 July, is the due day and is included. Payment received on 10 July is on time; on 11 July the invoice is past due.

## Late fee, worked (hypothetical)

An overdue invoice of USD 2400.00 at 1.5 percent per month carries USD 36.00 for the first month or part month unpaid, and a further USD 36.00 for each further month or part month.

## Application of payments

| Owner's instruction | Invoice the payment is applied to |
|---|---|
| names an invoice | that invoice |
| names none | the oldest unpaid invoice |
